name: Yang Zongbao
description: Yang Zongbao, one of the generals of the Yang family, was a representative of loyalty to the country in ancient China. When he was young, he went to fight with his father everywhere. He made many military exploits and was respected by the world. There is a saying in folk proverbs that "a young man is better than Yang Zongbao". When the Liao army invaded, he and his wife Mu Guiying worked together to break through the Tianmen Formation and defend the territory of the Song Dynasty; when the south rebelled, he fought on the battlefield to protect the peace of the people; when the Xixia invaded, he charged into the battle and died heroically. His patriotism and national sentiments were touching and have been praised to this day.
